data.description: crates/easyvox-core/tests/download.rs range_ignored failed once (2026-10-10, gates run right after a long bench) at the assert resumed_at > 0 (line 518): the retry started from byte 0 instead of resuming. Passed on 3 reruns and in CI. Likely a race between the simulated cut at 1 MiB and the .part flush under load. Find the race; make the test deterministic rather than retrying it.
data.title: Flaky test: download range_ignored sometimes restarts from 0
